name: model-router
description: Keeps the Claude model and reasoning effort Claude names for every subagent, agent-team teammate and workflow agent within your cap, fills in the effort nobody named, and runs a marked redo with more effort or on a stronger model.

routing_mode.title: Routing mode
routing_mode.description: auto (default): the model and effort Claude names on each subagent call are kept within your limits, and an effort nobody named is set. off: no routing.

max_tier.title: Strongest model allowed
max_tier.description: The most capable model subagents may run on: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Anything stronger is lowered to it. Leave as none for no cap.

verify_gate.title: Check before finishing
verify_gate.description: On by default, as this plugin's own choice. When files in the project changed and no check ran afterwards, Claude is asked once, before it finishes a turn, to run the work's own check: tests, build or linter for code, a recompute for figures, a reread against the request for a document. That costs one more turn. Set it to false to skip the ask.
